subject.title: Skills: apply tool policy to direct slash dispatch

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled PR be closed as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78525, or should the branch be revived with a fresh port of current-main policy handling?
rationale: Automation should not auto-close a MEMBER-authored, maintainer-labeled PR, and the remaining choice is branch ownership rather than a safe repair on the stale head.

options.title: Close as Superseded
options.body: Close this PR because the merged successor already shipped the stronger fix and this branch still has security-boundary gaps.

options.title: Revive With Fresh Port
options.body: Keep the PR open only if a maintainer wants to replace its helper with current-main resolver behavior and updated tests.

options.title: Keep Paused
options.body: Leave it open as a protected placeholder while a maintainer decides whether any branch-specific discussion still matters.

recommendation.title: Close as Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR because the merged successor already shipped the stronger fix and this branch still has security-boundary gaps.
